After that, venture west. Then, attempt to go to the north. Then, make an effort to travel north. If you can finish that, take a trip west. Then, take a trip south. Then, make an attempt to head east. After that, make an effort to go east. Next, go east. And then, take a trip east. And then, venture east. With that over with, make an attempt to move north. With that accomplished, try to go to the west. Then, pick up the coin from the floor of the office. Got that? Good!
